en.headline: 379 commits, 4 PRs and 50 issues across OpenCode tooling and research skills
en.teaser: Most of the window went into a daily-activity site, a deep-research skill family and several OpenCode plugins, alongside bug reports filed against OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The 30-day window from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-28 has data for every day; no dates are missing. Grand totals are 379 commits, 4 pull requests, 50 issues and 0 reviews, with 563 additional automated commits recorded separately.

### Daily activity site and profile repo

The largest share of work landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where a daily GitHub activity report was built on Pages with an AI-written summary. It was later changed to roll every two hours, the summary was made more detailed, and a series of fixes followed: dark-mode readability, the headline contract, inline code and bold rendering in release summaries, the code background colour, and a rendering regression test. The workflow also gained a manual date input.

### Research and translation skills

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` moved from an initial skill to a family of cooperating skills, adding a bilingual landing page, a Chinese README, an observations evidence type, validation scripts and CI, and rules for sources that cannot be opened. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 extension with a provider protocol layer, presets, glossary pipeline, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and page-state reset between runs.

### OpenCode plugins and tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, and shipped release candidates and a stable 1.0.0. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` collected knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication and Windows path issues. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts plus atomic snapshot writes, and `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` shipped v1.15.0 through v1.15.3 with a registry-first host-command scan and skill reference refactors.

### Upstream reports

Outside the user's own repositories, most activity was issue reporting. Twenty-four issues went to `openchamber/openchamber` covering session retention hints, quote cards, file-view commenting, context panel percentages, capture resolution and model switching, and twelve went to `anomalyco/opencode` covering MiMo vision handling, subagent failures and Windows CLI access. Smaller reports went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` and the two OpenSenseNova skill repositories. Four pull requests were closed in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, covering review-server disposal, CRLF frontmatter, platform-specific browser commands and eval robustness.

highlights.text: Reported an AI narration generation failure in the daily activity site.
Published v0.1.0 through v0.4.0, ending with a thin meld.py CLI wrapping the six gate scripts.
Shipped v1.0.0, freezing the list, inspect, disable and enable surface for 1.x.
Released v1.15.0 with a registry-first host-command scan.
Opened a bug about the session retention hint still describing the old archived-sessions checkbox.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images.
Closed a fix disposing review servers on plugin unload.
Started an idea to comment on selected code rather than only selected line numbers.

zh.headline: 379 次提交、4 个 PR、50 个 issue，集中在 OpenCode 工具与研究技能
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入每日活动站点、深度研究技能家族和多个 OpenCode 插件，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了大量缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
2026-09-29 至 2026-10-28 的 30 天窗口每天都有数据，没有缺失日期。总计 379 次提交、4 个拉取请求、50 个 issue、0 次评审，另有 563 次自动提交单独统计。

### 每日活动站点与个人仓库

工作量最大的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，在 Pages 上搭建了带 AI 摘要的每日 GitHub 活动日报。之后改为每 2 小时滚动更新，摘要写得更详细，并陆续修复了深色模式可读性、headline 契约、Release 摘要中的行内代码与加粗渲染、代码底色以及渲染回归测试，工作流也增加了手动指定日期的输入。

### 研究与翻译技能

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 从单个技能扩展为协作技能家族，新增双语落地页、中文 README、observations 证据类型、校验脚本与 CI，以及无法打开的来源的处理规则。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从零起步，做成 MV3 扩展，包含 provider 协议层、预设、术语表流水线、分块、熔断和两次翻译之间的页面状态重置。

### OpenCode 插件与工具

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，并发布了候选版本和稳定的 1.0.0。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 归档了 OpenCode V2 分发、认证和 Windows 路径问题的知识笔记。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本并改为原子写入，`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 从 v1.15.0 发到 v1.15.3，主机命令扫描改为注册表优先并重构了技能引用。

### 上游问题反馈

在本人仓库之外，活动以提交 issue 为主。`openchamber/openchamber` 收到 24 个 issue，涉及会话保留提示、引用卡片、文件视图评论、上下文面板百分比、截图分辨率和模型切换；`anomalyco/opencode` 收到 12 个，涉及 MiMo 视觉处理、子代理失败和 Windows 命令行入口。另有少量报告提交到 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` 和两个 OpenSenseNova 技能仓库。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 关闭了 4 个拉取请求，分别处理评审服务器释放、CRLF frontmatter、平台相关浏览器命令和评测健壮性。

highlights.text: 报告了每日活动站点的 AI 叙述生成失败问题。
发布了 v0.1.0 至 v0.4.0，最后以 meld.py 命令行封装六个门禁脚本。
发布 v1.0.0，将 list、inspect、disable、enable 接口在 1.x 内冻结。
发布 v1.15.0，主机命令扫描改为注册表优先。
提交了会话保留提示仍在描述旧版“仅归档会话”复选框的缺陷。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
关闭了在插件卸载时释放评审服务器的修复。
发起了针对选中代码而非仅选中行号添加评论的想法。
